issues.legal_issue: A claimant cannot obtain a decree for possession of property after it has vested in the state under the applicable land reform law.
material_facts: The suit sought possession of properties that had vested in the state before the court decided the appeal.
The applicable land reform provision governed the effect of that vesting.
issues.conclusion: The claim for a decree for possession could not succeed, and the dismissal of that claim was confirmed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 6 of the Bihar Land Reforms Act, 1950, precluded a decree for possession once the suit properties had vested in the State Government.

predicates.possession_suit: The proceeding includes a claim seeking possession of property.
predicates.property_vested_in_state: The property became vested in the state under the applicable land reform law.
predicates.possession_decree_unavailable: A decree granting possession of the property cannot be obtained.

issues.definition: When a proceeding seeks possession of property that has vested in the state, a possession decree is unavailable.

issues.legal_issue: A claimant is entitled to mesne profits for a period during which the opposing party wrongfully possessed the property before it vested in the state.
material_facts: The opposing parties were wrongfully in possession of the properties during the period for which mesne profits were claimed.
The claimed period ran from the filing of the suit until the properties vested in the state.
The court directed an inquiry into mesne profits limited to that period.
issues.conclusion: The claimant was entitled to an inquiry and decree for mesne profits for the period of wrongful possession before vesting, but not beyond that period.
issues.legal_principle: A person whose property is wrongfully possessed by another is entitled to mesne profits for the period of that wrongful possession; the court limited the award to the period before vesting in accordance with Section 6 of the Bihar Land Reforms Act, 1950. No earlier cases were cited.

predicates.mesne_profit_claim_in_property_suit: The claimant seeks mesne profits in a proceeding concerning property.
predicates.wrongful_possession_during_claimed_perio: The opposing party wrongfully possessed the property during the period for which mesne profits are sought.
predicates.claimed_period_before_state_vesting: The period for which mesne profits are sought falls before the property vested in the state.
predicates.mesne_profits_awarded_for_prevesting_per: Mesne profits are awarded for the period of wrongful possession before the property vested in the state.

issues.definition: If a claimant seeks mesne profits in a property proceeding and the opposing party wrongfully possessed the property during the claimed period before state vesting, mesne profits are awarded for that pre-vesting period.
